title: Declination
description: Declination ACDC used by the joint-issuance threshold operators. A signed declination asserts that its issuer (i) declines to endorse the subject identified by 'said' for the act named in 'act'. It records authenticated, attributable dissent. A declination never counts toward a threshold; its presence (as opposed to a pending placeholder) distinguishes a candidate who was asked and refused from one who has not yet acted.

s.description: SAID of the schema applied to this ACDC.

a.description: Attributes block. Compact form: SAID string. Expanded form: object naming the subject declined and the act declined.

said.description: SAID of the subject the issuer declines to endorse, typically the dossier ACDC.

act.description: The act being declined, mirroring the Endorsement schema: 'issue' for an MxN or MxQ issuance, 'revoke' for an RMxN or RMxQ revocation.

reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation for the declination.
